description:
Fetch one saved agent by id. ``agent_id`` comes from ``list_agents``
        or ``create_agent``.

        Returns the ``AgentResponse`` as a dict (``name``, ``system_prompt``,
        ``first_message``, ``ai_disclosure``, ``voice_config``, ``tools``,
        ``voice_enabled``, ``sms_enabled``, ``status``, ...), or
        ``{"error": "<message>"}``.
name: get_agent
title: Get an agent
